items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过特制文档执行本地代码，对终端用户工作站构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Kernel allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges locally, potentially granting full system control.
items.reason_zh: Windows内核中的释放后使用漏洞允许已认证的攻击者在本地提升权限，可能导致完全控制系统。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Win32K provides a reliable local privilege escalation vector targeting the graphical subsystem.
items.reason_zh: Windows Win32K中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞提供了一种针对图形子系统的可靠本地权限提升途径。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in .NET Framework can trigger arbitrary local code execution when processing malicious serialized objects.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework中对不受信任数据的反序列化在处理恶意序列化对象时可触发任意本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: A critical heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Message Queuing enables remote code execution over the network, posing an immediate threat due to its 9.8 CVSS score and widespread enterprise deployment.
items.reason_zh: Windows Message Queuing中的关键堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，因其CVSS评分高达9.8且在企业中广泛部署，构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: GDI+ heap overflow allows unauthorized remote code execution via processed images, making it highly exploitable in common document and email attachment workflows.
items.reason_zh: GDI+堆溢出漏洞允许通过处理的图像实现未经授权的远程代码执行，使其在常见的文档与电子邮件附件处理工作流中极易被利用。

items.reason_en: Flawed authentication implementation in the SMB server permits network-based privilege escalation, directly endangering critical file-sharing and domain controller communications.
items.reason_zh: SMB服务器中缺陷的身份验证机制允许基于网络的权限提升，直接危及关键的文件共享与域控制器通信。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Remote Desktop Client allows remote code execution over the network, threatening ubiquitous terminal access infrastructure used across organizations.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，威胁各组织广泛使用的终端访问基础设施。

items.reason_en: DHCP server heap overflow enables adjacent network attackers to execute arbitrary code, jeopardizing core network address allocation and routing services.
items.reason_zh: DHCP服务器堆溢出漏洞允许相邻网络攻击者执行任意代码，危及核心的网络地址分配与路由服务。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Windows Server Update Service allows network-based privilege escalation, potentially disrupting automated enterprise patch management pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Windows Server Update Service中缺失的身份验证机制允许基于网络的权限提升，可能破坏自动化的企业补丁管理流程。

items.reason_en: AD FS stack-based buffer overflow enables remote denial of service, targeting critical identity federation services that authenticate users across modern hybrid environments.
items.reason_zh: AD FS栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程拒绝服务，针对的是在现代混合环境中负责用户身份验证的关键身份联合服务。

items.reason_en: This critical CVSS 9.3 flaw involves an unauthenticated use-after-free in the Windows Kernel, allowing local privilege escalation without prior user interaction, which severely compromises endpoint integrity.
items.reason_zh: 这一CVSS评分为9.3的关键漏洞涉及Windows内核中无需身份验证的释放后使用漏洞，允许在无用户交互的情况下实现本地权限提升，严重损害终端完整性。

items.reason_en: A race condition in the Windows Print Spooler Components enables network-based code execution, highlighting persistent risks in core Windows printing subsystems.
items.reason_zh: Windows Print Spooler Components 中的竞争条件可导致基于网络的代码执行，凸显了核心 Windows 打印子系统中持续存在的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in the Windows MIDI Service Module allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges locally, expanding the attack surface for peripheral-driven exploits.
items.reason_zh: Windows MIDI Service Module 中的访问控制不当允许授权攻击者在本地提升权限，扩大了针对外设驱动型漏洞利用的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client enables unauthorized network code execution, posing a critical threat to remote administration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可触发未授权的基于网络的代码执行，对远程管理工作流构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: GDI+ heap overflow allows local code execution through malicious image processing, targeting a heavily exploited Windows subsystem.
items.reason_zh: GDI+ 堆溢出漏洞可通过恶意图像处理实现本地代码执行，直接针对被频繁利用的 Windows 子系统。

items.reason_en: Win32K use-after-free vulnerability provides a reliable local privilege escalation path in modern Windows kernel drivers.
items.reason_zh: Win32K 释放后使用（UAF）漏洞为现代 Windows 内核驱动程序提供了可靠的本地提权路径。

items.reason_en: Detached-tree mount path resolution flaw allows intermediate symlink traversal, bypassing restricted directory boundaries.
items.reason_zh: 分离树（detached-tree）挂载路径解析缺陷允许进行中间符号链接遍历，从而绕过受限目录边界。

items.reason_en: Unpinned bind mounts enable local users to redirect SUID mount(8) to arbitrary host directories, escalating privileges.
items.reason_zh: 非固定绑定挂载（unpinned bind mounts）使本地用户能够将 SUID mount(8) 重定向至任意主机目录，进而实现提权。

items.reason_en: nsenter cgroup file descriptor leak across namespace changes facilitates container escapes and privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: nsenter 在命名空间切换时产生的 cgroup 文件描述符泄漏问题，助长了容器逃逸与权限提升行为。

items.reason_en: SFTP backend buffer overflow allows malicious servers to corrupt client memory during file reads, causing crashes or code execution.
items.reason_zh: SFTP 后端缓冲区溢出漏洞允许恶意服务器在文件读取过程中破坏客户端内存，从而导致程序崩溃或代码执行。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in GIMP's FITS plugin calculates undersized memory allocations for crafted images, leading to heap corruption. This poses a direct threat to desktop creative workstations processing untrusted media.
items.reason_zh: GIMP 的 FITS 插件中存在整数溢出漏洞，会为特制图像计算过小的内存分配，进而导致堆损坏。该漏洞直接威胁到处理不可信媒体文件的桌面创意工作站。

items.reason_en: An off-by-one error in GIMP's PNM parser writes past a stack-allocated buffer boundary, potentially enabling local code execution. Users handling malicious image files face immediate stability and security risks.
items.reason_zh: GIMP 的 PNM 解析器存在一处差一（off-by-one）错误，会导致数据越界写入栈分配缓冲区，可能引发本地代码执行。处理恶意图像文件的用户将面临即时稳定性与安全风险。

items.reason_en: Adobe XD's buffer overflow vulnerability enables arbitrary code execution upon opening a malicious file, directly impacting desktop creative professionals.
items.reason_zh: Adobe XD 的缓冲区溢出漏洞在打开恶意文件时可触发任意代码执行，直接危及桌面创意专业人士的工作环境。

items.reason_en: OriginLab OriginPro's memory corruption flaws allow remote code execution through crafted scientific data files, requiring minimal user interaction.
items.reason_zh: OriginLab OriginPro 的内存损坏漏洞允许通过特制科学数据文件实现远程代码执行，且仅需极少的用户交互。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android enables network-based spoofing attacks targeting mobile users.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可支持针对移动用户的基于网络的欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: Path traversal flaw in Microsoft Teams for Android permits unauthorized remote code execution, compromising mobile endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的路径遍历漏洞允许未授权的远程代码执行，从而破坏移动终端的安全性。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS allows privilege escalation, potentially exposing sensitive organizational data on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: iOS 版 Microsoft 365 Copilot 中的访问控制不当可导致权限提升，进而可能泄露移动设备上的敏感企业数据。

items.reason_en: A ToCTOU race condition in Microsoft Edge for Android allows remote code execution via malicious web content, highlighting ongoing vulnerabilities in mobile browser engines.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Edge 中存在时间检查到使用时间（ToCTOU）竞争条件漏洞，允许通过恶意 Web 内容实现远程代码执行，凸显了移动浏览器引擎中持续存在的安全隐患。

items.reason_en: UI layer restriction flaws in the Bing App for iOS enable network-based spoofing attacks, directly threatening mobile user trust and session integrity.
items.reason_zh: iOS 版 Bing App 中的 UI 层限制缺陷可支持基于网络的欺骗攻击，直接威胁移动用户的信任度与会话完整性。

items.reason_en: External control of file paths in Microsoft Edge for Android allows local information disclosure, posing a risk to sensitive data stored on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Edge 中的文件路径外部可控漏洞可导致本地信息泄露，对移动设备上存储的敏感数据构成风险。

items.reason_en: Third-party app UI manipulation combined with phishing can escalate attacker privileges within the Android ecosystem.
items.reason_zh: 结合网络钓鱼攻击对第三方应用 UI 进行操纵，可在 Android 生态系统中实现攻击者权限提升。

items.reason_en: Denial of service vulnerability in Cisco SIP software affects IP phones and video endpoints, disrupting critical communication infrastructure in IoT deployments.
items.reason_zh: Cisco SIP 软件中的拒绝服务（DoS）漏洞会影响 IP 电话和视频终端，从而破坏物联网部署中的关键通信基础设施。

items.reason_en: Oxford Nanopore MinKNOW relies solely on client IP for authentication, leaving biotech lab equipment vulnerable to spoofing and unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: Oxford Nanopore MinKNOW 仅依赖客户端 IP 地址进行身份验证，导致生物技术实验室设备易受 IP 欺骗与未授权访问威胁。

items.reason_en: Wyoming SSRF allows unauthenticated attackers to force outbound connections to arbitrary targets, compromising voice assistant and edge computing integrations.
items.reason_zh: Wyoming 中的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞允许未认证攻击者强制发起指向任意目标的出站连接，从而破坏语音助手与边缘计算的集成环境。

items.reason_en: Embedded RSA modulus in firmware allows attackers to sign and flash malicious storage controller updates, bypassing integrity checks.
items.reason_zh: 固件中硬编码的 RSA 模数使得攻击者能够签名并刷入恶意的存储控制器固件更新，从而绕过完整性校验机制。

items.reason_en: CGI command injection in D-Link NAS devices enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands with minimal interaction.
items.reason_zh: D-Link NAS 设备中的 CGI 命令注入漏洞允许远程攻击者在极少交互的情况下执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Exposed vendor commands with defeatable CRC-16 authentication permit unauthorized read/write access to storage controllers.
items.reason_zh: 暴露的厂商命令若仅采用易被攻破的 CRC-16 认证机制，将允许未授权方对存储控制器进行读写操作。

items.reason_en: Unescaped template substitution in IoT message mappers enables injection of arbitrary device properties, disrupting fleet management.
items.reason_zh: IoT 消息映射器中存在未转义的模板替换漏洞，允许注入任意设备属性，从而干扰设备集群管理。

items.reason_en: OS command injection via media definitions in Westermo WeOS allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands on managed edge devices. This highlights critical supply chain risks in industrial IoT networking hardware.
items.reason_zh: 通过 Westermo WeOS 中的媒体定义可触发操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许攻击者在受管边缘设备上执行任意命令。该漏洞凸显了工业物联网网络设备中严峻的供应链安全风险。

items.reason_en: Critical privilege escalation in the ServiceNow AI platform allows unauthenticated users to modify instance data beyond intended permissions.
items.reason_zh: ServiceNow AI 平台中存在严重的权限提升漏洞，允许未认证用户修改超出预期权限范围的实例数据。

items.reason_en: Suffix-based path matching flaw bypasses authentication on Kestra's configuration endpoint, enabling full system compromise and actively exploited in the wild.
items.reason_zh: 基于后缀的路径匹配漏洞可绕过 Kestra 配置端点的身份验证机制，导致系统被完全接管，且该漏洞已在野外被积极利用。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Azure Arc allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network, impacting hybrid cloud environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中的错误授权漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过网络提权，影响混合云环境。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication for critical functions in Azure Kubernetes Service enables unauthorized privilege escalation and potential cluster takeover.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中关键功能缺失身份验证，可导致未授权提权及潜在的集群接管风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure CycleCloud allows network attackers to elevate privileges, potentially compromising cloud workload orchestration and tenant isolation boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中缺失授权机制，允许网络攻击者提权，可能破坏云工作负载编排及租户隔离边界。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Azure Storage Explorer enables privilege escalation over the network, risking unauthorized access to sensitive cloud storage accounts and configuration data.
items.reason_zh: Azure Storage Explorer 中存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可被用于网络提权，导致未授权访问敏感云存储账户及配置数据的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Power BI enables remote code execution, creating significant risks for SaaS environments processing sensitive business analytics.
items.reason_zh: Power BI 中存在输入验证不当漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，给处理敏感业务分析数据的 SaaS 环境带来严重安全风险。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows remote code execution, exploiting a well-known attack vector in enterprise collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，该漏洞利用了企业协作平台中常见的攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID enables remote code execution without authentication, severely compromising cloud identity management.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，可在未认证的情况下触发远程代码执行，严重威胁云身份管理体系。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Key Vault allows unauthorized privilege escalation, risking exposure of cryptographic secrets and cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault 中缺失身份验证机制，允许未授权提权，可能导致加密密钥及云工作负载暴露。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Azure Cosmos DB permits remote code execution, threatening data integrity in major NoSQL cloud databases.
items.reason_zh: Azure Cosmos DB 中存在访问控制不当漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，威胁主流 NoSQL 云数据库的数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated MCP session binding in argocd-mcp allows attackers to invoke full operator tool surfaces, endangering Kubernetes cluster management.
items.reason_zh: argocd-mcp 中存在未认证的 MCP 会话绑定漏洞，允许攻击者调用完整的运维工具接口，危及 Kubernetes 集群管理安全。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse enables remote code execution, threatening cloud-native analytics and data processing workloads.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse 中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，威胁云原生数据分析与处理工作负载。

items.reason_en: Improper validation in Red Hat Submariner's certificate authentication mode allows configuration injection, compromising Kubernetes cluster networking and security policies.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Submariner 的证书认证模式存在验证不当漏洞，可导致配置注入，破坏 Kubernetes 集群的网络与安全策略。

items.reason_en: Marked as actively exploited in CISA KEV, weak authentication in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows unauthorized security feature bypass, risking widespread enterprise data exposure.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞已被 CISA KEV 列为活跃利用状态，Microsoft Office SharePoint 中存在的弱身份验证机制允许未授权绕过安全功能，可能导致大规模企业数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Improper header handling in Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management allows request impersonation, risking unauthorized control over managed Kubernetes clusters and container workloads.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management 中存在请求头处理不当漏洞，可导致请求伪装，危及受管 Kubernetes 集群及容器工作负载的未授权控制。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure CycleCloud permits network-based privilege escalation, directly impacting cloud workload management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中关键功能缺失身份验证，允许基于网络的提权，直接影响云工作负载管理基础设施的安全。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in the Azure Connected Machine Agent allows adjacent network privilege escalation, undermining secure hybrid-cloud device onboarding.
items.reason_zh: Azure Connected Machine Agent 中存在证书验证不当漏洞，允许相邻网络提权，破坏了混合云设备安全接入流程。

items.reason_en: Listed in CISA KEV, this AD FS vulnerability features insufficient access control granularity, enabling local privilege escalation in critical identity federation pipelines.
items.reason_zh: 该 AD FS 漏洞已被列入 CISA KEV，其访问控制粒度不足，可导致关键身份联合服务中的本地提权。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Service enables unauthenticated privilege escalation across managed container clusters.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中缺失身份验证机制，可导致受管容器集群间的未授权提权。

items.reason_en: SSRF in Azure OpenAI allows attackers to pivot to internal cloud resources and exfiltrate sensitive tenant data.
items.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 中存在服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，允许攻击者横向移动至内部云资源并窃取敏感租户数据。

items.reason_en: SSRF in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service compromises identity synchronization infrastructure, risking tenant-wide security breaches.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service 中存在 SSRF 漏洞，会破坏身份同步基础设施，引发租户级安全事件。

items.reason_en: Kyverno policy exception handling flaw allows attackers to bypass enforcement rules by crafting specific resource names that trigger precedence bugs.
items.reason_zh: Kyverno 的策略异常处理逻辑存在缺陷，攻击者可构造特定资源名称以触发优先级判定漏洞，从而绕过策略强制执行规则。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded JWK security disable in KrakenD API Gateway permits JWT forgery and complete authentication bypass.
items.reason_zh: KrakenD API Gateway 中硬编码禁用了 JWK 安全校验，可导致 JWT 伪造及完整的身份验证绕过。

items.reason_en: Subuser permission bypass allows privilege escalation to full server control via crafted API requests to the update handler.
items.reason_zh: 子用户权限绕过漏洞允许攻击者通过向更新处理器发送构造的 API 请求，实现提权至完全服务器控制权。

items.reason_en: Incorrect Windows binary permissions enable local privilege escalation through executable replacement in unprivileged installations.
items.reason_zh: Windows 二进制文件权限配置错误，允许攻击者在非特权安装环境中通过替换可执行文件实现本地提权。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Kibana Fleet settings allows low-privileged users to delete critical system resources.
items.reason_zh: Kibana Fleet 设置中存在路径遍历漏洞，允许低权限用户删除关键系统资源。

items.reason_en: Weak IAM condition validation in OIDC trust policies allows attackers to bypass cloud security guardrails using wildcard operators.
items.reason_zh: OIDC 信任策略中 IAM 条件验证强度不足，攻击者可利用通配符操作符绕过云安全管控策略。

items.reason_en: TOCTOU race condition in repository uploads enables remote code execution via precise concurrent request timing.
items.reason_zh: 仓库上传功能中存在 TOCTOU 竞争条件漏洞，攻击者可通过精确控制并发请求时序实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: SSRF via pre-receive hooks allows internal service impersonation and remote code execution due to insufficient network isolation.
items.reason_zh: 预接收钩子（pre-receive hooks）引发的 SSRF 漏洞，因网络隔离不足可导致内部服务伪装及远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: OpenStack Ironic executes grub-install within a chroot of deployed partition images, enabling remote code execution if a malicious image is provisioned. This directly compromises bare-metal cloud infrastructure automation.
items.reason_zh: OpenStack Ironic 会在已部署分区镜像的 chroot 环境中执行 grub-install，若投放恶意镜像则可触发远程代码执行，直接破坏裸机云基础设施的自动化安全。

items.reason_en: Team Password Manager fails to enforce authentication during local account password resets, allowing unauthenticated privilege escalation. This severely undermines identity and access management in cloud-hosted deployments.
items.reason_zh: Team Password Manager 在本地账户密码重置过程中未强制实施身份验证，允许未授权提权，严重削弱了云托管部署中的身份与访问管理能力。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited unauthenticated SQL injection in Sangoma Switchvox SMB Edition allows remote attackers to execute database queries and gain system control.
items.reason_zh: Sangoma Switchvox SMB Edition 中存在被主动利用的未认证 SQL 注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行数据库查询并获取系统控制权。

items.reason_en: Command injection in the HPE Networking Fabric Composer web interface enables unauthenticated remote attackers to run arbitrary host commands.
items.reason_zh: HPE Networking Fabric Composer Web 界面存在命令注入漏洞，使未认证的远程攻击者能够运行任意主机命令。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Windows NAT allows adjacent network attackers to perform traffic spoofing and intercept communications.
items.reason_zh: Windows NAT 中的源验证错误允许相邻网络攻击者进行流量欺骗并拦截通信。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows DNS permits remote code execution over the network, critically endangering essential DNS resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，严重危及关键的 DNS 解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows DNS enables remote code execution, representing a high-severity flaw in a widely targeted network service.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可启用远程代码执行，属于广泛受关注网络服务中的一处高危缺陷。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server allows remote code execution, directly impacting critical organizational email and communication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，直接影响关键的企业电子邮件与通信基础设施。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution with root privileges in Cisco Nexus 9000 Silicon One integration compromises core switching infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Cisco Nexus 9000 Silicon One 集成模块中可获取 root 权限的远程代码执行漏洞会危及核心交换基础设施。

items.reason_en: Critical vulnerabilities addressed in Cisco IOS XR hardening releases affect router operating systems, mitigating potential remote exploitation at the network edge.
items.reason_zh: Cisco IOS XR 加固版本修复的高危漏洞影响路由器操作系统，有助于缓解网络边缘潜在的远程利用风险。

items.reason_en: Malformed HTTP response handling in NGINX JavaScript can crash worker processes, causing denial of service for reverse proxy deployments.
items.reason_zh: NGINX JavaScript 对畸形 HTTP 响应的处理不当可导致工作进程崩溃，致使反向代理部署发生拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: Injection vulnerabilities in the F5 NGINX Ingress Controller configuration generator allow authenticated attackers to manipulate underlying NGINX configurations, disrupting traffic routing.
items.reason_zh: F5 NGINX Ingress Controller 配置生成器中的注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者操纵底层 NGINX 配置，从而破坏流量路由。

items.reason_en: Asynchronous access-control evaluation flaws in F5 NGINX JavaScript engines permit unauthenticated attackers to bypass security restrictions and execute arbitrary requests.
items.reason_zh: F5 NGINX JavaScript 引擎中的异步访问控制评估缺陷允许未认证攻击者绕过安全限制并执行任意请求。

items.reason_en: F5 BIG-IP TMUI flaw allows authenticated users to create administrative accounts, directly compromising network management planes.
items.reason_zh: F5 BIG-IP TMUI 漏洞允许已认证用户创建管理员账户，直接危及网络管理平面。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution over the network without authentication, impacting critical infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许无需认证的远程代码执行，影响关键基础设施。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows DNS allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network, threatening core name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过网络提权，威胁核心名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server allows network-based code execution, threatening foundational IP address management services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，威胁基础 IP 地址管理服务。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows SSTP enables unauthenticated remote code execution over networks, exposing VPN tunneling infrastructure to direct compromise.
items.reason_zh: Windows SSTP 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许未经认证的远程代码执行，使 VPN 隧道基础设施面临直接被攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the Windows DHCP Client allows network-based privilege escalation, creating widespread risk across enterprise network configurations.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Client 中的整数下溢漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，在企业网络配置中造成广泛风险。

items.reason_en: Looking Glass SSRF vulnerability enables internal network reconnaissance and potential exploitation of router-facing services behind firewalls.
items.reason_zh: Looking Glass 的 SSRF 漏洞可实现内部网络侦察，并潜在利用防火墙后方面向路由器的服务。

items.reason_en: HPE Credential Manager flaw permits unauthenticated administrative access on factory-default networking and security appliances before initial configuration.
items.reason_zh: HPE Credential Manager 缺陷允许在未初始配置的情况下，以未认证方式访问出厂默认的网络与安全设备的管理权限。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows FTP Service exploits legacy network protocol handling, threatening file transfer infrastructure and legacy integrations.
items.reason_zh: Windows FTP Service 中的远程代码执行漏洞利用了遗留网络协议处理机制，威胁文件传输基础设施及遗留集成环境。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated arbitrary file write in HPE AOS-CX API enables remote code execution on managed network switches.
items.reason_zh: HPE AOS-CX API 中的未认证任意文件写入漏洞可在受管网络交换机上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: OS-level authentication bypass allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to execute privileged code on Fabric Composer hosts.
items.reason_zh: 操作系统级身份验证绕过漏洞允许未认证的相邻网络攻击者在 Fabric Composer 主机上执行特权代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated RCE in the underlying OS completely compromises network management infrastructure under specific preconditions.
items.reason_zh: 在特定前提条件下，底层操作系统的未认证远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞将完全危及网络管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: API privilege escalation grants operator users full administrative control, leading to complete platform compromise.
items.reason_zh: API 权限提升漏洞赋予操作员用户完全的管理控制权，导致平台被彻底攻陷。

items.reason_en: Daemon input processing flaw enables unauthenticated remote code execution via specially crafted network packets.
items.reason_zh: 守护进程输入处理缺陷允许通过特制的网络数据包实现未认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: FIPS mode assertion failure on malformed certificates causes remote denial of service in Libreswan VPN gateways.
items.reason_zh: Libreswan VPN 网关在处理畸形证书时发生 FIPS 模式断言失败，导致远程拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: A format string vulnerability in HPE AOS-CX CLI enables unauthenticated remote code execution on the switch's underlying OS. This critically destabilizes enterprise routing and switching infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: HPE AOS-CX CLI 中的格式化字符串漏洞允许在交换机底层操作系统上实现未认证的远程代码执行，严重破坏企业路由与交换基础设施的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Insufficient validation of JMX service URLs in Jolokia bypasses existing denylists, granting unauthorized access to management interfaces. This exposes network monitoring and telemetry appliances to takeover.
items.reason_zh: Jolokia 对 JMX 服务 URL 的验证不足可绕过现有拒绝列表，授予对管理接口的未授权访问，使网络监控与遥测设备面临被接管的风险。

items.reason_en: Dell PowerStore's missing authentication flaw permits unauthenticated remote attackers to access the underlying filesystem, severely compromising enterprise storage security.
items.reason_zh: Dell PowerStore 缺失身份验证的缺陷允许未认证的远程攻击者访问底层文件系统，严重危及企业存储安全。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated RCE in Seagull BarTender label printing software directly threatens manufacturing and logistics supply chain operations.
items.reason_zh: Seagull BarTender 标签打印软件中的未认证远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞直接威胁制造与物流供应链运营。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Autodesk DXF parser allows arbitrary code execution when processing engineered CAD files in industrial design environments.
items.reason_zh: 在工业设计环境中处理工程化CAD文件时，Autodesk DXF解析器的堆溢出漏洞可导致任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Basic user privilege abuse allows modification and deletion of critical engineering projects, impacting operational continuity.
items.reason_zh: 普通用户权限滥用可修改或删除关键工程项目，影响业务连续性。

items.reason_en: Authenticated low-level users can achieve remote code execution on Rockwell FactoryTalk Historian Machine Edition. This directly threatens OT data acquisition systems and manufacturing operational continuity.
items.reason_zh: 已认证的低级用户可在Rockwell FactoryTalk Historian Machine Edition上实现远程代码执行。这直接威胁OT数据采集系统及制造运营连续性。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated OAuth2 passthrough fallback in LiteLLM allows credential theft and API abuse, actively exploited in production environments.
items.reason_zh: LiteLLM中未认证的OAuth2透传回退机制可导致凭证窃取和API滥用，且已在生产环境中被活跃利用。

items.reason_en: Decoding attacker-controlled TOON data pollutes Object.prototype, which can break application logic or facilitate cross-site scripting attacks.
items.reason_zh: 解码攻击者控制的TOON数据会污染Object.prototype，可能导致应用逻辑崩溃或辅助跨站脚本攻击。

items.reason_en: Stored cross-site scripting in Microsoft SharePoint enables unauthorized network-based spoofing and session hijacking against end users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint中的存储型跨站脚本漏洞可使攻击者对终端用户实施未经授权的基于网络的身份欺骗与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Malicious PHP dependencies can exploit the Perforce client to execute arbitrary commands during automated dependency resolution workflows.
items.reason_zh: 恶意PHP依赖项可利用Perforce客户端在自动化依赖解析工作流中执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Microsoft Exchange Server allows unauthorized network attackers to elevate privileges, directly threatening enterprise email infrastructure and data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server的身份验证绕过漏洞允许未经授权的网络攻击者提升权限，直接威胁企业电子邮件基础设施与数据机密性。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in SharePoint enables remote code execution over the network, allowing attackers to fully compromise web-facing collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的不安全反序列化漏洞支持通过网络进行远程代码执行，使攻击者能够完全控制面向Web的协作平台。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in SharePoint permits authorized attackers to pivot internally and escalate privileges, exposing backend services and metadata to exploitation.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的服务端请求伪造(SSRF)漏洞允许已授权攻击者向内网横向移动并提权，导致后端服务和元数据暴露于被利用的风险中。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server facilitates spoofing attacks, undermining web interface integrity and potentially enabling credential theft.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的跨站脚本漏洞助长欺骗攻击，破坏Web界面完整性，并可能导致凭证窃取。

items.reason_en: Security feature bypass in the VS Code Copilot Chat Extension over the network compromises developer toolchain security and AI-assisted coding workflows.
items.reason_zh: 通过网络触发的VS Code Copilot Chat Extension安全功能绕过漏洞，破坏了开发者工具链安全性及AI辅助编码工作流。

items.reason_en: Insufficient reset token validation in a popular WordPress theme enables account takeover and privilege escalation, targeting widespread CMS deployments.
items.reason_zh: 某流行WordPress主题的重置令牌验证不足漏洞可导致账户接管与权限提升，广泛影响CMS部署环境。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows remote code execution, jeopardizing enterprise collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中对不受信任数据进行反序列化可导致远程代码执行，危及企业协作平台。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in pac4j-core reverses profile type validation, allowing attackers to access restricted resources using weaker credentials.
items.reason_zh: pac4j-core中的身份验证绕过漏洞反转了用户资料类型验证逻辑，使攻击者能够使用较弱凭证访问受限资源。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in the Chromium-based Edge browser enables remote code execution when processing malicious web content, representing a high-value target for exploit kits.
items.reason_zh: 基于Chromium的Edge浏览器中的类型混淆漏洞在处理恶意Web内容时可导致远程代码执行，使其成为漏洞利用套件的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data in Edge allows remote code execution, expanding the attack surface for phishing and drive-by download campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Edge中对不受信任数据进行不安全的反序列化可导致远程代码执行，扩大了网络钓鱼与旁路下载活动的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in Edge can be leveraged to perform spoofing attacks and access internal network resources through crafted browser interactions.
items.reason_zh: Edge中的服务端请求伪造(SSRF)漏洞可通过构造的浏览器交互被用于实施欺骗攻击并访问内部网络资源。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based spoofing attacks by authorized users, compromising web application integrity.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞使已授权用户能够发起基于网络的欺骗攻击，破坏Web应用程序完整性。

items.reason_en: Craft CMS GraphQL resolvers bypass site-scope filtering, allowing authenticated users to read or delete content entries outside their authorized boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Craft CMS的GraphQL解析器绕过了站点范围过滤，允许已认证用户读取或删除超出其授权边界的内容条目。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV) with an EPSS score of 0.84, this SharePoint deserialization flaw allows unrestricted network code execution, representing an immediate critical threat.
items.reason_zh: 该SharePoint反序列化缺陷EPSS评分为0.84，且已在野外被活跃利用（列入CISA KEV），允许无限制的远程代码执行，构成迫在眉睫的重大威胁。

items.reason_en: Another critically exploited SharePoint deserialization vulnerability (CISA KEV) that enables remote code execution, demonstrating persistent weaknesses in legacy web frameworks.
items.reason_zh: 另一处被严重利用的SharePoint反序列化漏洞（列入CISA KEV）可导致远程代码执行，凸显了遗留Web框架中持续存在的弱点。

items.reason_en: GraphQL resolver flaws in Craft CMS bypass site-scope filtering, allowing unauthorized data manipulation and compromising multi-tenant web applications.
items.reason_zh: Craft CMS中的GraphQL解析器缺陷绕过了站点范围过滤，允许未经授权的数据操作，危及多租户Web应用程序。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in a popular WordPress helpdesk plugin leads to full administrator account takeover, exploiting a massive install base for immediate compromise.
items.reason_zh: 某流行WordPress帮助台插件的身份验证绕过漏洞可导致完整的管理员账户接管，利用其庞大的安装基数实现即时入侵。

items.reason_en: CraftCMS allows password changes without verifying current credentials, enabling straightforward account takeover for authenticated users.
items.reason_zh: CraftCMS允许在未验证当前凭证的情况下更改密码，使已认证用户能够轻易接管账户。

items.reason_en: Wallos OIDC callback lacks SSRF filtering, allowing attackers to redirect requests to internal endpoints via crafted token URLs.
items.reason_zh: Wallos的OIDC回调缺乏SSRF过滤机制，攻击者可通过构造的令牌URL将请求重定向至内部端点。

items.reason_en: ASP.NET Core authentication bypass via assumed-immutable data undermines session integrity for enterprise web applications.
items.reason_zh: 通过假定不可变数据实现的ASP.NET Core身份验证绕过漏洞，破坏了企业Web应用程序的会话完整性。

items.reason_en: Broken password recovery token validation enables indefinite account takeover via reuse of expired reset links.
items.reason_zh: 密码恢复令牌验证机制失效使得通过重用过期重置链接实现持续的账户接管成为可能。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted file upload in WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated PHP backdoor deployment for immediate server compromise.
items.reason_zh: WordPress插件中的无限制文件上传漏洞允许匿名用户部署PHP后门，立即导致服务器被控。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted debugging console permits any authenticated user, including subscribers, to execute arbitrary server-side code.
items.reason_zh: 无限制的调试控制台允许任何已认证用户（包括订阅者）执行任意服务器端代码。

items.reason_en: Admin flag persistence during registration enables account takeover when public registration and email verification are enabled.
items.reason_zh: 注册期间管理员标志持久化，在启用公开注册和邮箱验证时会导致账户接管。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in marketing forms allows complete database compromise and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: 营销表单中的未授权SQL注入可导致数据库完全沦陷及数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Weak connect token brute-forcing enables unauthenticated plugin installation and subsequent remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 弱连接令牌暴力破解可实现未授权插件安装及后续远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Customer type parameter manipulation enables privilege escalation to administrator roles via insufficient validation.
items.reason_zh: 通过篡改客户类型参数，利用验证不足实现提权至管理员角色。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated privilege escalation in the Authorizer WordPress plugin allows attackers to seize full administrative control. This demonstrates persistent threats in widely deployed CMS ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Authorizer WordPress插件中的未授权提权漏洞使攻击者能够获取完整的管理控制权。这揭示了广泛部署的CMS生态系统中存在的持续性威胁。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in WCFM Marketplace enables complete database manipulation or exfiltration in WooCommerce environments. E-commerce platforms face severe data breach and financial risks.
items.reason_zh: WCFM Marketplace中的未授权SQL注入可在WooCommerce环境中导致数据库被完全操控或数据外泄。电商平台面临严重的数据泄露与财务风险。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary file deletion in SigmaForms Pro stems from insufficient path validation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to destroy critical system files. Web form handlers require strict sanitization to prevent catastrophic damage.
items.reason_zh: SigmaForms Pro中的任意文件删除漏洞源于路径验证不足，允许未授权攻击者破坏关键系统文件。Web表单处理器需进行严格过滤以防止灾难性损害。

items.reason_en: WebKitGTK's improper memory handling during web content rendering can lead to remote code execution, affecting major Linux-based browsers and applications.
items.reason_zh: WebKitGTK在网页内容渲染期间的内存处理不当可能导致远程代码执行，影响主流基于Linux的浏览器及应用。

items.reason_en: cPanel's eval injection vulnerability allows authenticated users to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary commands as root on web hosting infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: cPanel的eval注入漏洞允许已认证用户提升权限，并在Web托管基础设施中以root身份执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: The WordPress WP File Download plugin suffers from insufficient path validation, enabling low-privileged attackers to delete arbitrary server files and disrupt services.
items.reason_zh: WordPress WP File Download插件存在路径验证不足问题，使低权限攻击者可删除任意服务器文件并中断服务。

items.reason_en: Critical default configuration weakness in JFrog Artifactory allows unauthenticated network access to obtain administrative privileges, actively exploited.
items.reason_zh: JFrog Artifactory的关键默认配置缺陷允许未授权网络访问获取管理员权限，且正遭活跃利用。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled recursion in Amazon Ion-C allows remote actors to craft data that exhausts the call stack and crashes dependent applications.
items.reason_zh: Amazon Ion-C中的无限制递归漏洞允许远程攻击者构造耗尽调用栈的数据，导致依赖应用崩溃。

items.reason_en: Improper buffer reparsing in the Predis Redis client can trigger memory corruption or unexpected behavior during cluster operations.
items.reason_zh: Predis Redis客户端中的缓冲区错误重解析可能在集群操作期间触发内存损坏或异常行为。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Active Directory Certificate Services enables remote code execution, threatening critical PKI operations and secure communications.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services中的释放后使用漏洞可致远程代码执行，威胁关键PKI操作与安全通信。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Local Security Authority Server allows remote code execution, jeopardizing core authentication and authorization mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Local Security Authority Server中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及核心认证与授权机制。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Azure SQL Database enables privilege escalation and data exfiltration, directly impacting relational database security.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database中的SQL注入漏洞可实现提权与数据外泄，直接影响关系型数据库安全。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Microsoft Exchange Online facilitates privilege escalation, compromising enterprise email and collaboration middleware.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Online中的服务端请求伪造漏洞可促成提权，致使企业邮件与协作中间件失陷。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution via Velocity templates in DSpace exposes digital repository applications to arbitrary command execution.
items.reason_zh: DSpace中通过Velocity模板实现的远程代码执行漏洞使数字仓储应用面临任意命令执行风险。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in the Extensible Storage Engine (ESENT) allows local privilege escalation, potentially compromising database-backed applications relying on this component.
items.reason_zh: Extensible Storage Engine (ESENT)中的访问控制不当漏洞允许本地提权，可能危及依赖该组件的数据库支持应用。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in .NET Core can trigger denial-of-service conditions over the network, impacting backend services and middleware architectures built on the framework.
items.reason_zh: .NET Core中的类型混淆漏洞可通过网络触发拒绝服务状态，影响基于该框架构建的后端服务与中间件架构。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SQL Server allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network, risking complete database compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的SQL注入漏洞允许已授权攻击者在网络上提权，面临数据库完全沦陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Active Directory Certificate Services enables privilege escalation over the network, undermining PKI trust models.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services中的授权不当漏洞允许通过网络提权，破坏PKI信任模型。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in .NET allows unauthorized network bypasses of security features, weakening application middleware defenses.
items.reason_zh: .NET中的授权不正确漏洞允许未经授权的网络绕过安全功能，削弱应用中间件防御能力。

items.reason_en: Nexus Repository 3 fails to enforce administrative script execution restrictions, enabling compromised developer accounts to run malicious scripts and potentially poison artifact pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Nexus Repository 3未能强制执行管理员脚本执行限制，使遭入侵的开发者账号可运行恶意脚本，并可能污染制品流水线。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Active Directory Domain Services enables network-based code execution, directly targeting the backbone of enterprise identity and access management.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services中的堆溢出漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，直接针对企业身份与访问管理骨干。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in .NET allows network-based security feature evasion, undermining application integrity checks across the ecosystem.
items.reason_zh: .NET中的加密签名验证绕过漏洞允许基于网络的安全功能规避，破坏整个生态系统中的应用完整性检查。

items.reason_en: Resource allocation flaws in ASP.NET Core permit unauthenticated denial of service, impacting the availability of modern web middleware deployments.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的资源分配缺陷允许未授权拒绝服务，影响现代Web中间件部署的可用性。

items.reason_en: SQL Server deserialization flaw permits remote code execution over the network by processing untrusted serialized objects.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server的反序列化缺陷允许通过处理不受信任的序列化对象在网络侧实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server facilitates account spoofing and credential harvesting in enterprise email environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server中的跨站脚本漏洞可促成企业邮件环境中的账户伪造与凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authentication algorithm implementation in ASP.NET Core weakens cryptographic verification for web application middleware.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中认证算法实现不正确会削弱Web应用中间件的密码学验证强度。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated internal replication server exposes the database without authentication, risking full data breach.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的内部复制服务器使数据库在无身份验证的情况下暴露，面临全面数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Baserow formula function allows low-privileged users to manipulate PostgreSQL queries directly.
items.reason_zh: Baserow公式函数中的SQL注入漏洞允许低权限用户直接操纵PostgreSQL查询。

items.reason_en: YAML merge key processing flaw enables denial of service through excessive memory consumption and resource exhaustion.
items.reason_zh: YAML合并键处理缺陷可导致拒绝服务（DoS），造成内存过度消耗与资源耗尽。

items.reason_en: Malicious 'type' fields in protobuf definitions trigger arbitrary code execution during object decoding in protobufjs. This compromises data serialization layers across modern microservice architectures.
items.reason_zh: protobuf定义中的恶意'type'字段会在protobufjs进行对象解码时触发任意代码执行，危及现代微服务架构中的数据序列化层。

items.reason_en: Weak polymorphic type validation in Jackson-databind allows array types to bypass security checks, increasing deserialization attack surfaces. Java-based middleware remains vulnerable to logic injection.
items.reason_zh: Jackson-databind中薄弱的多态类型验证允许数组类型绕过安全检查，增加反序列化攻击面。基于Java的中间件仍易受逻辑注入影响。

items.reason_en: Lenient HTTP/2 :path pseudo-header validation in gRPC-Go bypasses authorization checks, enabling unauthenticated service access. High-performance RPC middleware requires stricter routing enforcement.
items.reason_zh: gRPC-Go对HTTP/2 :path伪头部验证过于宽松，可绕过授权检查从而实现未授权服务访问。高性能RPC中间件需实施更严格的路由控制。

items.reason_en: Code injection vulnerability in Visual Studio Code allows remote code execution over the network, severely impacting developer environments and CI/CD pipeline security.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的代码注入漏洞允许通过网络远程执行代码，严重影响开发环境和CI/CD流水线安全。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Microsoft Copilot enables information disclosure over the network, posing significant risks to AI-assisted development workflows and proprietary code.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Copilot中的命令注入漏洞可导致网络信息泄露，对AI辅助开发工作流和专有代码构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Outlook allows remote code execution over the network, targeting a ubiquitous email client and facilitating sophisticated phishing-driven compromises.
items.reason_zh: Outlook中的整数溢出漏洞允许通过网络远程执行代码，针对广泛使用的电子邮件客户端，并助长复杂的钓鱼驱动型入侵。

items.reason_en: Command injection in PowerShell allows local code execution, which can be easily chained with other vulnerabilities to achieve full system compromise and persistence.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell中的命令注入漏洞允许本地代码执行，可轻松与其他漏洞结合以实现系统完全沦陷和持久化驻留。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code allows remote code execution over the network, affecting developer workstation security.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中缺失的授权机制允许通过网络远程执行代码，影响开发者工作站安全。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated binding of Keploy agent endpoints exposes TLS session keys, enabling decryption of encrypted application traffic.
items.reason_zh: Keploy代理端点的未认证绑定会暴露TLS会话密钥，从而能够解密加密的应用程序流量。

items.reason_en: Logic flaw in the Prevail eBPF verifier silently skips register updates, potentially allowing unsafe eBPF programs to bypass kernel safety checks.
items.reason_zh: Prevail eBPF验证器中的逻辑缺陷会静默跳过寄存器更新，可能允许不安全的eBPF程序绕过内核安全检查。

items.reason_en: Inclusion of functionality from untrusted control spheres in Visual Studio Code allows sandbox escapes, endangering developer environments and potentially leading to host compromise.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中包含来自不受信任控制域的功能会导致沙箱逃逸，危及开发环境并可能导致主机沦陷。

items.reason_en: Sudo fails to enforce intercept policies on the execveat system call, allowing users to bypass command restrictions and logging mechanisms in ptrace-based monitoring setups.
items.reason_zh: Sudo未能对execveat系统调用执行拦截策略，使用户能够在基于ptrace的监控环境中绕过命令限制和日志记录机制。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows Terminal enables local code execution, increasing the risk of exploitation within administrative and development console sessions.
items.reason_zh: Windows Terminal中的整数溢出漏洞允许本地代码执行，增加了在管理和开发控制台会话中被利用的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper file resource restriction in GitHub Copilot allows local code execution, posing risks to developer workflows and IDE security.
items.reason_zh: GitHub Copilot中不当的文件资源限制允许本地代码执行，对开发者工作流和IDE安全构成风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server permits remote code execution over the network, exposing game hosting environments.
items.reason_zh: Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络远程执行代码，暴露游戏托管环境。

items.reason_en: The PREVAIL eBPF verifier incorrectly handles ALU32 arithmetic on pointer registers, potentially allowing malicious eBPF programs to bypass safety checks and exploit the host kernel.
items.reason_zh: PREVAIL eBPF验证器错误处理指针寄存器上的ALU32算术运算，可能允许恶意eBPF程序绕过安全检查并利用主机内核。

items.reason_en: A critical flaw in the PREVAIL eBPF abstract transformer silently ignores certain memory writes, creating a severe risk of kernel exploitation via crafted eBPF bytecode.
items.reason_zh: PREVAIL eBPF抽象转换器中的关键缺陷会静默忽略某些内存写入操作，通过构造的eBPF字节码带来严重的内核利用风险。

items.reason_en: Uncaught exceptions in Windows Server Update Service allow network-based tampering, potentially disrupting patch management and software distribution workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows Server Update Service中未捕获的异常允许基于网络的篡改，可能破坏补丁管理和软件分发工作流。

items.reason_en: HTTP/2 resource exhaustion flaws allow unauthenticated denial of service, affecting web servers and reverse proxies handling high-volume traffic.
items.reason_zh: HTTP/2资源耗尽漏洞允许未认证的拒绝服务攻击，影响处理高并发流量的Web服务器和反向代理。

items.reason_en: rpmuncompress command injection in Linux package management tools risks local privilege escalation during automated CI/CD builds.
items.reason_zh: Linux包管理工具中rpmuncompress的命令注入漏洞在自动化CI/CD构建期间存在本地提权风险。

items.reason_en: Joro web exploitation framework exposes an unauthenticated local API with wildcard CORS, facilitating cross-origin payload delivery for attackers.
items.reason_zh: Joro Web利用框架暴露了带有通配符CORS的未认证本地API，便于攻击者投递跨源载荷。

items.reason_en: Job ID normalization flaw enables path traversal and arbitrary file writes via unauthenticated API endpoints.
items.reason_zh: 作业ID规范化缺陷可通过未认证API端点实现路径遍历和任意文件写入。

items.reason_en: A race condition between device teardown and IGMP query processing triggers a use-after-free in the Linux kernel. This can lead to kernel panics or privilege escalation on networked systems.
items.reason_zh: 设备拆除与IGMP查询处理之间的竞争条件会触发Linux内核中的释放后使用（Use-After-Free）漏洞。这可能导致联网系统的内核崩溃或权限提升。

items.reason_en: Improper handling of incoming ICMP packets on IPPROTO_RAW sockets allows remote exploitation without prior connection establishment. Core kernel networking stacks require hardened packet filtering.
items.reason_zh: 在IPPROTO_RAW套接字上不当处理传入ICMP数据包允许在未建立连接的情况下进行远程利用。核心内核网络栈需要强化数据包过滤。

items.reason_en: Incorrect VMLOAD/VMSAVE emulation in nested SVM environments may leak guest state or cause virtualization instability. Hypervisor security relies on precise state translation across CPU architectures.
items.reason_zh: 嵌套SVM环境中错误的VMLOAD/VMSAVE模拟可能泄露客户机状态或导致虚拟化不稳定。Hypervisor安全性依赖于跨CPU架构的精确状态转换。

items.reason_en: pnpm's path traversal flaw in scoped package manifests during installation introduces supply chain risks by allowing unauthorized file reads or writes.
items.reason_zh: pnpm在安装过程中对作用域包清单的路径遍历缺陷引入了供应链风险，允许未经授权的文件读取或写入。

items.reason_en: SUSE YaST's OS command injection via Active Directory configuration values allows compromised directory controllers to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges.
items.reason_zh: SUSE YaST通过Active Directory配置值实现的操作系统命令注入漏洞，可使被攻陷的目录控制器以root权限执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Red Hat dracut's lack of shell quoting in initramfs error messages creates a boot-time injection vector exploitable by adjacent network attackers controlling DHCP responses.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat dracut在initramfs错误消息中未正确进行Shell引号转义，从而产生了一个启动阶段的注入向量，可被能够控制DHCP响应的相邻网络攻击者利用。
